decisions.rationale: The complete technical compound directly attests divisive speech. No PHRA/divisive member is invented without independently established member evidence.
PHA ROL directly attests others, the targets of division in the first definition. It is not the later capital Others naming a different interpretive group.
The complete DBYE BA glossary directly attests split up. The bound genitive ending is outside this verb.
Purpose PHYIR owns meant to as grammatical purpose, with direct is meant to/for/to glossary candidates. There is no extra source meant verb.

First full afflicted expression supplies tight capital Afflicted. The broader mentally afflicted state glossary candidate is counterevidence to treating every gloss word as separately owned; mentally remains unbanked around the explicit SEMS/state noun.

SEMS is the mind/state-of-mind noun, locally rendered state after the afflicted qualification. Complete glossary state of mind and reference state of thought support this contextual noun; the separate mentally modifier stays unwrapped rather than doubly claimed.
This KYI after SEMS owns the explicit of linking words to the mental state. The earlier GYI inside the afflicted-state description has no second of here.
The independent TSHIG after the mental-state phrase supplies words. It is distinct from the next TSHIG within harsh speech.
Complete technical compound directly attests harsh speech; exclude the English copular support.
Speech is the unique full English member of the harsh-speech parent, owned by its explicit TSHIG; this is not the preceding independent words noun.
The complete RTSUB PO glossary directly attests harsh. Its full capital English word is uniquely inside the parent; no interior English stem is cut.
The complete negative adjective construction directly attests unpleasant. Keep it whole as a phrase; SNYAN PA has good/pleasant material but no unauthorized positive pleasant interior span is banked.
Second full afflicted expression belongs to the definition of meaningless speech and owns the second, lowercase afflicted.
The explicit totalizer KUN supplies the first every in this universal definition. The later every other is an English restatement, not a second KUN.
The complete KYAL PA glossary directly attests meaningless. The technical speech noun is elliptical in the verse, so no source speech token or false English addition is fabricated.

NYID is the emphatic particle: reference eva and glossary precisely/real support the local really emphasis. The current clause and fuller commentary clarify this emphasis; no claim that the glossary literally lists really is made.
First GZHAN names other interpreters, rendered capital Others. It does not refer to the people divided by speech earlier in the verse.
Second GZHAN contrasts kinds of afflicted speech, rendered tight other. DE LAS supplies the comparison with the earlier kinds but is not given the same word twice; every and type stay unbanked.
The bare afflicted expression has a direct afflicted glossary sense and owns the third such English word, within the alternative definition.
Complete KHA GSAG directly attests flattery for gain. This is a lexical compound, not separate fabricated mouth/gain members.
GLU directly attests song, excluding the article.
ZLOS GAR directly attests show. The preceding source DANG corresponds to list punctuation here, not a word taken from the final negative coordination.
First BZHIN supplies the lowercase like governing the flattery/song/show examples. Its reference like/as is relevant; the mined let’s say is not required as an English restoration.
The complete technical noun directly attests commentaries. It is not a newly supplied source commentary title.
NGAN directly attests wrong for the commentaries, distinct from the following capital Wrong describing desire.
Second BZHIN owns capital Like in the additional commentary example. Too remains an English additive without a separate source word.
Complete BRNAB SEMS directly attests coveting, the next mental action. Its component mind is not separately present inside the single English word.

The inflected complete LOG PAS qualifies desire, rendered Wrong. Raw LOG PAS has no exact master entry; base LOG PA directly attests wrong and the local case-inflected form is retained whole, never splitting final -s.
This GZHAN is the possessor of wealth, rendered apostrophe-delimited another. It is distinct from the two earlier GZHAN occurrences; possessive apostrophe-s remains outside.
NOR directly attests wealth in the coveting definition. The mistake sense from the previous lying definition does not apply.
LA links desire to its object and owns for. The preceding GYI belongs to the possessor relationship and is not assigned this same for.
CHAGS directly attests desire, qualified by Wrong. Its other material formation/become senses do not fit this clause.
Complete GNOD SEMS directly attests harmful intent. The English phrase names the mental action, not its following target.
The harm component supplies the full adjectival Harmful inside the established compound. Base GNOD directly attests harm/hurt; no prohibited interior harm cut is used.
SEMS directly attests intent, unique inside this parent. It is not the earlier SEMS/state or the later SEMS CAN/living being.
Complete SEMS CAN directly attests living being. No invented mind/living or CAN/being decomposition is forced from the mind-having etymology.
SDANG BA directly attests hating. The dative LA marks its object but has no separate printed preposition before living being.
Bare DGE directly attests the first virtue. It is distinct from the DGE component of the later negative compound.
The coordinator between virtue and non-virtue is rendered Nor under the shared MED negation. This is the local negative coordination, not a dictionary claim that every DANG means nor.
Complete MI DGE directly attests non-virtue, preserving its printed hyphen and whole negative lexical category.

The unique DGE member owns the complete hyphen-delimited virtue member within non-virtue. This does not cut an interior unhyphenated stem or introduce a fifth subword exception; no MI/non subword is added.

The first LTA BA is the held view, locally recast as idea before its content clause. The master attests view rather than literal idea; this contextual nominal correspondence remains provisional and is distinct from the final technical mistaken-view compound.
The complete technical compound directly attests mistaken view. It identifies the category whose separate LTA BA/idea content precedes it in Tibetan.
Whole LOG PAR directly attests mistaken and is a unique member inside the technical parent. No English mis- affix is cut.
Whole LTA BA directly attests view inside this parent. Its earlier independent source occurrence owns idea, not this same English view.

omissions.tib: bound genitive after dbye ba; gyi before sems; topic ni forms; de las; dang between glu and zlos gar; gyi after the wealth possessor; la before sdang ba; final yin
omissions.reason: Purpose, mental-state attribution, alternative-school comparison, example-list punctuation, possessive/object relations and final classification distribute their English support. Selected PHYIR/meant to, KYI/of and LA/for do not license extra arbitrary words or nulls.

MED is the negative-existence predicate, unfolded as neither...Nor...even exists. The whole content is discontinuous around already selected virtue categories; neither an exclusive partial negator nor false positive MED/exists is banked. DANG/Nor represents local coordination under that shared negation.

omissions.english: the; a; mentally; is that which is; second every; type; too; possessive apostrophe-s; the idea that articles/complement framing; even exists
omissions.reason: These articles, mental qualification, copular/relative support and expanded alternative-definition/negative-existence framing stay exact outside the chosen words. LTA BA owns only the contextual head idea, not the whole complement clause.

omissions.tib: members of phra ma, kha gsag, brnab sems and sems can; mi in mi dge; snyan pa inside mi snyan pa
omissions.reason: No speculative member is forced into an English word or etymological paraphrase. Only complete, uniquely anchored harsh-speech, harmful-intent, hyphenated virtue and mistaken-view members are proposed. No unauthorized non, pleasant, harm or mis interior subword cut.
